results.title: r/dotnet on Reddit: How to implement a SFTP file subscriber or detector which will automatically detect that file has arrived ?
results.snippet: If your sftp server is Linux, use incrond, which will fire a script on file events. The incrond (inotify cron daemon) monitors filesystem events (such as add a new file, delete a file and so on) and executes commands or shell scripts.
